problem_statement: The event_periodic_callback module must provide a header event/periodic_callback.h and an API that lets a program set up periodic callbacks. A program must be able to declare objects of type event_periodic_callback_t and call event_periodic_callback_init(obj, ZTIMER_MSEC, EVENT_PRIO_MEDIUM, callback, arg), event_periodic_callback_set_count(obj, count), and event_periodic_callback_start(obj, interval). The configured callback must be invoked periodically at the requested interval, up to the configured count, with the argument passed to init, and multiple configured objects must fire in time order. The supplied test initializes three objects with counts 6, 3, and 2 and intervals 502, 1001, and 1500 ms, sleeps 3020 ms, and expects the outputs in the order: event A, event B, event A, event C, event A, event B, event A, event A, event C, event B, event A.
